implementation.approach: unmodified plugin artifact in one exact Linux sample lock, run against stock native framework and production Core/Host/Gateway in a network-disabled Docker Worker

windows_sandbox_blocker.reason: Windows Sandbox App Control policy blocked the unsigned CPython executable; the failure occurred before the sample runner started.

native_paths.nonebot: stock NoneBot 2.5.0 with official OneBot v11 adapter 2.4.6; inject native OneBot Event through Bot.handle_event and capture Bot API sends
native_paths.koishi: stock Koishi core 4.18.11 Context/Session/Bot; dispatch native Session and capture Bot.sendMessage
